summary: Verified the preview-not-loading fix. https://prism-check-1.preview.emergentagent.com/ now loads cleanly (Cloudflare challenge clears in ~2s), title 'Prism — Diligence, made consistent' renders, #root has ~28.7k chars of markup, and hero copy 'The numbers should add up' plus 'CROSS-DOCUMENT CONSISTENCY CHECKER', 'Run a diligence check', 'View sample report', 'Sign in with Google' are all visible. All 5 nav routes (/, /upload, /dashboard, /privacy, /terms) render properly. Backend reachable through the ingress: re-ran the full pytest suite against the public URL — 12/12 pass in ~12s, including the full happy-path e2e (upload -> analyze -> poll -> report -> PDF download). Preview-loading bug is fixed. Discovered a pre-existing (unrelated) frontend bug in the sample-company loader.

minor.issue: Still returns 422 (FastAPI-native) when no valid UploadFile is provided; unchanged from iteration_1.

ui_bugs.component: Upload.tsx — 'Load sample company' / 'Clean startup' / 'Messy startup' buttons
ui_bugs.issue: In real (non-mock) mode, frontend/src/api/client.ts uploadDocuments() falls into the else branch and calls formData.append('files', f.filename), i.e. it POSTs the filename as a plain string. Backend expects UploadFile and responds 422 with pydantic 'Expected UploadFile, received: <class str>' for every file. Result: all three one-click sample buttons on /upload are non-functional against the live backend. Reproduced by clicking 'Load sample company' — API 422 error is even rendered on screen.

integration_issues.flow: One-click sample company / clean / messy startup demo
integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot bootstrap a demo session because it does not have the fixture files client-side. Needs either a dedicated backend endpoint (e.g. POST /api/sample/{name}) or the frontend must fetch fixture blobs from /public and post them as real File objects.

action_items: Fix Upload.tsx sample loaders: either add backend POST /api/sample/{clean|messy} that seeds a session from server-side fixtures, or ship fixture files under /public and have loadSampleInstantly()/loadSampleSet() fetch(blob) -> File -> FormData. The current filename-string fallback in api/client.ts:79 is dead code against the real backend.
Preview fix itself needs no further action — verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api/client.ts:79 — `formData.append('files', f.filename)` is a silent bug: it satisfies the TS type but produces a 422 against FastAPI. Either delete this branch and require File, or make it call a distinct endpoint.
vite.config.ts allowedHosts:true is broad; fine for a preview env but should be restricted for production.
No HMR now (production build served by vite preview) — any frontend edit requires a rebuild + supervisorctl restart frontend; document this in README so future iterations don't lose time.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (all routes render, but the primary sample-company CTA is broken)

test_credentials: Authorization: Bearer demo-token (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). sessionStorage.prism_auth_token is null on fresh load because VITE_FIREBASE_* are set so AuthContext waits for a real Google sign-in; unauthenticated API calls still work because backend accepts anonymous.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview-loading fix (yarn start -> vite build && vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000) is verified end-to-end. Frontend is now a static build with no HMR — rebuild via `cd /app/frontend && yarn build && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` after any src change. Regression suite: `cd /app/backend && PRISM_BASE_URL=https://prism-check-1.preview.emergentagent.com pytest tests/test_prism_api.py -v`. Known open frontend bug: sample-company loader posts filename strings instead of files -> 422.
rca of the issue: Original bug: `yarn start` ran Vite in dev mode; HMR websocket + on-demand transpile requests were causing Cloudflare/emergent proxy to keep serving the interstitial challenge indefinitely. Fix: switched supervisor's yarn start to `vite build && vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --strictPort`, added allowedHosts:true and hmr wss:443 in vite.config.ts. Confirmed: index.html now references hashed dist assets, root mounts in ~2s, Cloudflare challenge no longer appears.
